annotations.title: Find and rank campuses by students and beds

description: Lists US four-year campuses (3,000+ full-time students) filtered by state, city, name words, sector, whether the college offers housing, Fannie Mae campus-size test, or minimum full-time enrollment, ranked by bed gap, enrollment, college beds, beds per 100 students or housing charge. Each row gives fall 2024 enrollment, 2024-25 college-controlled beds, bed gap, housing charge and the campus page link.

fannie_campus_size_test.description: true = only campuses with 10,000+ students, majority full-time (Fannie Mae Dedicated Student Housing campus-size test).

name.description: Words from the campus name, e.g. "state university".

offers_housing.description: true = only colleges that provide housing; false = only those that provide none.

name: search_campuses
